title: Artifact ingress, binary conversion, and deterministic validation for community models
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Objective: Build a resilient end-to-end ingestion path for community-submitted LLM artifacts that covers (1) secure artifact ingress, (2) automated binary conversion to our runtime format, and (3) deterministic validation and profile publishing. This ticket implements the orchestration and glue logic (CRs, transform workers, and verification harness) and defines acceptance criteria for model admission into the public catalog.

Scope:
- Ingest artifacts from S3/HTTP uploads and GitHub release links.
- Verify provenance and checksum, extract model files and metadata.
- Run conversion pipeline (format normalization, quantization-aware checks) into .rbin runtime artifact.
- Execute deterministic validation suite: small-scale forward pass checks, reproducible sample generations, KV-cache sanity, and perf microbenchmarks for default sequence lengths.
- Publish versioned performance profile and quality signals to the model catalog.

Non-goals:
- Full-scale benchmarking across all instance types (separate work).
- Automated policy decisions about pinning to paid tiers — this ticket only publishes profiles and flags candidates for manual review.
acceptance_criteria: Uploaded artifact accepted and quarantined with a signed ingress record
Conversion produces .rbin runtime artifact plus a deterministic conversion log
Validation harness runs with a pass/fail verdict and produces a small profile (latency, peak mem, token throughput) for default sequences
Model appears in internal staging catalog with a unique version tag and performance profile
Automated alerts created for failures with actionable reasons (checksum mismatch, unsupported layer, OOM during conversion)
An exportable audit bundle (ingest metadata, conversion log, validation report) is attachable to the model record
technical_decisions: Use a short-lived quarantine bucket for initial artifacts to limit blast radius (decided 2025-02-06)

Adopt ONNX as intermediate normalization format for CPU-parallel conversion steps; runtime will recompile to kernel-native .rbin (trade-off: ONNX adds an extra conversion step but simplifies model ops mapping)
Deterministic RNG seeds and fixed model config snapshots are required for validation runs to ensure reproducible sample outputs
Validation harness will run on a constrained instance profile (4 vCPU, 32GB RAM, single A10G) to bound cost and allow fast failures; full perf matrix in later epic
